license_documentation.strategy: No specific font is distributed, required, or proposed for approval; the SVG uses a generic system-font fallback stack solely for visual review.
license_documentation.review_requirement: Before selecting a real typeface, record its exact name and version, source, license, and permitted logo use.

limitations: This is a review-only placeholder/system-font mock, not an approved wordmark, final candidate, or master.
The SVG relies on locally available system fonts; rendering, metrics, kerning, and line placement may vary by environment.
No font file is committed or externally referenced.
No exact typeface provenance or license is asserted because no specific font is selected or distributed.
The locked symbol is not included, copied, redrawn, retraced, or altered.
This artifact cannot be used for runtime, public, export, or lockup production.
review_checklist: Assess letter character and literary/editorial feel.
Assess distinctiveness while recognizing that this is a placeholder stack.
Assess potential fit next to the locked symbol without treating this artifact as a lockup.
Assess kerning and spacing, allowing for environment-dependent rendering.
Decide whether the licensing approach is acceptable or a documented specific typeface is required.
Decide whether this direction may proceed to a real wordmark candidate.
Decide whether outlines may later be created after font and license confirmation.
Decide whether light/dark lockup candidate preparation may later proceed.
next_steps: Complete human visual review and record whether the direction should stop, be revised, or proceed.
If proceeding, select and document an exact typeface, version, source, license, and logo-use rights in a separate approved task.
Create outlines only after explicit approval and font/license confirmation.
Prepare any light/dark lockup candidate only after separate explicit approval.
